import math
commercial_banks = 77688
mutual_savings_banks = 4206
ratio = commercial_banks / mutual_savings_banks
ln_ratio = math.log(ratio)
print(f'Commercial banks: {commercial_banks}')
print(f'Mutual savings banks: {mutual_savings_banks}')
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')
print(f'Natural log of ratio: {ln_ratio}')
print(f'Rounded to thousandths: {round(ln_ratio, 3)}')
